crazy_taxi_2.name: C_TAXI02.SYS
crazy_taxi_2.description: CT2 System Data / CRAZY TAXI 2 SYSTEM DATA
crazy_taxi_2.vms_crc: valid under the production save parser (8104 payload bytes, 3 icons)

cause: Crazy Taxi 2 writes 0x10 in the directory entry's copy-protect byte. kui_vmu_image_validate accepted only 0x00 or 0xff there, so session recovery refused the card (stage SESSION, session IMAGE). Every other rule passed; no orphan or shared block, chains and FAT consistent.
not_the_cause: Memory corruption: the save's own CRC is valid and the filesystem is otherwise consistent.
fix: The copy-protect byte is opaque: kui_vmu_image_validate, kui_vmu_image_pack and the DCI save parser accept and preserve any value.
